STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE (SOP)
DEPARTMENT: CUSTOMER CARE (POST-SALE SUPPORT)
1. INTRODUCTION: WELCOME TO THE HEART OF THE CLINIC
Welcome to the Dharma Nutrition Customer Care Team. While the Sales Team brings patients through
the door, you are the reason they stay.
This document serves as your Master Playbook. It outlines the precise steps and protocols required to
support patients after they have committed to their health journey. From guiding them through medical
forms to scheduling their nutritional coaching, you are the bridge between the patient and their results.
2. THE PURPOSE OF THIS SOP
In the medical weight loss industry, a sale is not the finish line—it is the starting line. The purpose of this
SOP is to ensure that every patient transitions smoothly from "New Client" to "Success Story."
Our goal is simple: Eliminate Friction. Whether it is a confusing medical form, a shipping delay, or a
scheduling conflict, your job is to solve the problem before the patient even feels stressed. We do not just
answer phones; we deliver peace of mind.
3. YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
As a Customer Care Agent, you wear three distinct hats during every shift:
● ⚡ The Problem Solver (Support & Resolution): You are the primary point of contact for all
questions after the payment is made. This includes checking order status, tracking shipments,
answering messages via text/email, and handling incoming support calls with patience and grace.
● 📅 The Coordinator (Logistics & Admin): You are the organizer behind the scenes. Your duties
include:
○ Medical Forms: assisting patients who struggle to fill out their health history.
○ Scheduling: Booking Medical Consultations and Nutritional Appointments efficiently.
○ Data Accuracy: Maintaining our spreadsheets and CRM to ensure no patient falls
through the cracks.
● 🌟 The Experience Creator (Reputation): You are the guardian of our brand's reputation. Every
interaction is an opportunity to earn a 5-Star Google Review. You ensure clients feel so
supported and cared for that they become advocates for Dharma Nutrition.
4. THE DHARMA STANDARD
Success in this role is defined by adhering to these non-negotiable principles:

● EMPATHY: Many patients are nervous about starting injections or frustrated with technology. We
treat every frustration with kindness, never annoyance.
● ACCURACY: A mistake in scheduling or a typo in a shipping address causes delays. We
double-check every spreadsheet entry and appointment time.
● THE "5-STAR" MINDSET: We do not end a conversation until the client is satisfied. Our standard
is excellence, ensuring that our Google Reviews reflect the high quality of care we provide.
Lead's channels

Master Lead Management Workflow: Sources & Tools
The Philosophy: Our leads arrive from multiple digital channels, but they all share one requirement:
Urgency. Whether a lead comes from a TikTok video or a Facebook Ad, they must be contacted
immediately.
1. Where Our Leads Come From (The Sources)
We actively generate interest across the following major platforms:
● Meta (Facebook & Instagram): Direct Messages (DMs) and Comments on posts/ads,
WhatsApp.
● TikTok: Direct Messages and engagement on viral content.
● Web Forms: Leads who fill out surveys or quizzes on our website.
2. How We Communicate (The Platforms)
Depending on the source, we use three distinct tools to manage communication. You must be proficient in
all of them.
A. Respond.io (WhatsApp & Messaging)
Primary Use: High-speed text communication.
● Function: This is our central hub for WhatsApp, TikTok, Instagram and Facebook.
● Action: Most social media leads are funneled here. You will use this for initial outreach,
answering questions quickly, and confirming appointments via text.
B. HubSpot (CRM & Email)
Primary Use: Data management
● Function: HubSpot is the "brain" of our operation.
● Action:
○ Inbox: Manage messages coming directly from the website chat.
○ Tasks: Manage daily follow-ups and missed appointment lists.
○ Database: This is where you verify client status, check notes, and update deal stages.
C. Phone System (Direct Calls)
Primary Use: Inbound and outbound calls.
● Function: Outbound and Inbound voice calls.
While digital messaging is efficient, the phone is our primary tool for resolving issues. You are responsible
for executing three specific types of outbound calls:
A. Missed Inbound Calls (Immediate Priority)

● Definition: Any incoming call that was not answered by an agent in real-time.
● The Rule: You must call back immediately upon seeing the missed call notification.
B. Message Follow-Ups (Stalled Conversations)
● Definition: Leads who started a conversation via Text/WhatsApp/DM but stopped replying before
booking.
● The Rule: Do not just wait for a text back. If a warm lead goes silent during a conversation, pick
up the phone.
● Action: Call them to break the silence and answer complex questions that are hard to type out.
C. No-Show Recovery
● Definition: Clients who had a scheduled appointment yesterday but did not attend.
● The Rule: These must be called daily at the start of the shift.
● Action: Follow the specific steps outlined in the Missed Calls SOP] (Call twice + Leave
Voicemail/Text).

Regardless of the platform—Respond.io, HubSpot, or Phone—treat every lead with the same level of
priority. A lead left waiting for more than 30 minutes is a lead lost.

Missed calls

Missed Call Recovery Process
Objective: Ensure every missed call is treated as a priority task to maximize lead recovery and maintain
high service standards.
1. Frequency & Routine
● Check Schedule: Review the missed call list in Aircall/HubSpot at the start of every hour.
● Standard: Do not leave missed calls sitting in the queue. Every missed call is an opportunity that
must be actioned.
2. Outbound Protocol
Follow the specific redial steps based on how the call was disconnected:
● Disconnected / Dropped Calls: Attempt to call back once immediately.
● Ring-outs (No Answer):
1. Call back immediately.
2. If they do not answer the first time, call back a second time right away (Double Dial).
3. If there is still no answer on the second attempt, leave a voicemail.
3. Scripts & Scenarios
Use the following scripts depending on the context of the missed call.
Scenario A: General Missed Call (Standard)
"Hi, this is [Your Name] from Dharma Nutrition Clinic. I’m calling because we see we just
missed a call from you. How can we help you today?"
● If interested in Weight Loss Treatment: Proceed to schedule the appointment immediately.
● If requesting General Information:
○ Attempt to answer their question and solve the issue immediately.
○ If you cannot solve it: "I will need to gather that information for you. Let me check on this
and I will give you a call back shortly."
Scenario B: Client Missed a Scheduled Video Call Use this when a client had a confirmed appointment
with an expert but did not answer.
"Hi [Client Name], this is [Your Name]. I see you had a video call scheduled with our expert
but were unable to connect. Would you like to reschedule that appointment now?"
● If Yes: Open the calendar and re-book immediately.

Time Zone Guide

Time Zone Reference & Conversion
Office Location: Boca Raton - Florida (Eastern Time).
Rule of Thumb: Most states change their clocks with us, so the hourly difference remains constant.
However, Arizona and Hawaii do not observe Daylight Saving Time, meaning their time difference
changes depending on the season.
1. Standard Time Zones (Move WITH Florida)
For these zones, the time difference is always the same year-round.
If it is 12:00 PM in Florida 	Time Zone 	Difference 	Key States
12:00 PM 	Eastern (ET) 	Same Time NY, NJ, GA, NC, PA, OH, VA
11:00 AM 	Central (CT) 	-1 Hour 	TX, IL, TN, MO, OK, WI, AL
10:00 AM 	Mountain (MT) 	-2 Hours 	CO, UT, NM, WY, ID (South)
9:00 AM 	Pacific (PT) 	-3 Hours 	CA, NV, WA, OR
2. The Exceptions (Do NOT Move with Florida)
⚠ Warning: Arizona and Hawaii do not observe Daylight Saving Time. The time difference changes
based on the season.
🌵 Arizona (Most of State)
● Summer (DST): Arizona aligns with Pacific Time (-3 Hours behind FL).
● Winter (Standard): Arizona aligns with Mountain Time (-2 Hours behind FL).
🌺 Hawaii (HI)
● Summer (DST): Hawaii is -6 Hours behind FL.
● Winter (Standard): Hawaii is -5 Hours behind FL.
3. The Golden Rule
Because of these variations, always verify the local time before calling clients in Arizona or Hawaii.

● Action: Simply Google "Current time in [City, State]" if you are unsure to avoid calling too early or
too late.

Confirmation Calls

ensuring the client receives their login details.

● Data Accuracy: The IT Department is responsible for populating the data in HubSpot. You will
rely on this data for your calls.
● Calendar View: You must have ALL Sales Representatives' calendars open simultaneously in
your browser. This is required to view the schedule holistically and confirm appointments
hour-by-hour.
2. Workflow Requirements
● Timing: Calls must be executed exactly 1 hour before the scheduled appointment time.
○ Reason: This ensures the client is reminded just before the meeting and allows us to fill
the slot immediately if they cancel.
● Sequence: Always process confirmations in chronological order (earliest appointments first).
● Preparation (Before Dialing):
○ Verify Name: Check the correct pronunciation of the client's name.
○ Check Context: Briefly review the "Deals" section in HubSpot for any specific notes or
history.
○ Locate Number: Retrieve the phone number from the HubSpot contact record or the
Calendar invite.
● Persistence (The Double Dial):
○ If the client does not answer the first call, you are required to call back immediately a
second time.
○ Why? Many people ignore single calls from unknown numbers but answer the second
attempt, realizing it might be important.

Speak clearly and enthusiastically.
"Hi, this is [Your Name] from Dharma Nutrition Clinic.
I’m calling just to quickly confirm your appointment with our specialist today at
[Appointment Time].
Please keep an eye on your messages—we will be sending you the secure link to join the
video call about 20 minutes before we start. We look forward to speaking with you soon!"
4. Outcome Logging

● Confirmed: Mark as confirmed in the spreadsheet/HubSpot.
● No Answer: Leave a voicemail (if available) and send a confirmation text via Respond.io.
● Cancellations: If they cancel during this call, immediately notify the Lead Management Team so
they can try to fill the open slot.

● Call Frequency: You must attempt to reach the client twice during this session if they do not
answer the first time (Double Dial).
2. The Call Script
Use a helpful, problem-solving tone. Do not sound accusatory.
"Hi [Client Name], this is [Your Name] from Dharma Nutrition.
I’m calling because I see we missed our consultation yesterday, and I wanted to make sure
we get you taken care of.
I actually have a new opening available [Today/Tomorrow] at [Time]. Would you like to
grab that spot so we can get you started?"

2. Confirm: Follow all standard steps in the Appointment Scheduling SOP (send calendar invite,
confirmation text).
3. HubSpot: Mark the "Missed Appointment" task as Completed and create the new
Deal/Appointment record.
Scenario B: No Answer (After 2 Attempts)
1. Voicemail: Leave a brief message on the second attempt.
○ "Hi [Name], it's [Name] from Dharma. I’m sorry we missed you yesterday. Please text or
call me back so we can reschedule your session. Thank you!"
2. Message: Send a text/WhatsApp via Respond.io.
○ "Hi [Name], sorry we missed you yesterday! Do you want to reschedule your call for later
today?
📲"
3. HubSpot: Log the call attempts and keep the task open for the next scheduled follow-up cycle.

Snippets

What are Snippets?
Definition: Snippets are pre-saved, standardized responses used in Respond.io to ensure
communication consistency and speed. Instead of typing the same message repeatedly, you can use a
Snippet to insert approved text instantly.
Why we use them:
● Speed: Drastically reduces response time.
● Accuracy: Ensures clients receive the correct information (pricing, links, medical info) without
typos.
● Consistency: Maintains the professional "Dharma Voice" across all agents.
How to use them: In the chat bar, type the forward slash symbol (/) followed by the keyword of the
snippet you need.
● Example: Typing /lejos instantly populates a response for clients who say they cannot attend the
appointment because they live too far away. This snippet clarifies that the appointment is a video
call and can be taken from the comfort of their home.
Important Note: Snippets are different from Templates.
● Snippets are for active conversations (standard replies).
● Templates are for re-opening conversations after the 24-hour window has closed.

GLP-1

Product Knowledge: Semaglutide & Tirzepatide
1. What are these medications?
Semaglutide and Tirzepatide are weekly injectable medications originally designed for blood sugar
regulation but now widely used for weight loss. They work by mimicking natural gut hormones that
control your appetite, digestion, and insulin response.
2. The Breakdown
A. Semaglutide (The Standard Option)
● Type: GLP-1 Agonist (Targets 1 Hormone).
● How it works: It mimics the GLP-1 hormone released after eating.
● Key Actions:
○ Significantly reduces appetite and food intake.
○ Slows down gastric emptying (makes you feel full for much longer).
○ Improves insulin sensitivity.
● Sales Context: This is the famous "active ingredient in Ozempic/Wegovy." It is highly effective
and the most common starting point.

distortion and is unpleasant for the client.

background chatter.

recorded line, wait one full second after hitting "record" before you start speaking. This
prevents your greeting from being cut off.

make the client ask follow-up questions; anticipate what they need to know next and
include it.
